premise: Fox and Deer think Woodpecker is knocking at the big tree's front door — tap tap, who's there? — until Fox listens with him and hears bugs under the bark: breakfast!
inspiration: The folk knock-knock "who's there?" game, answered truly: the tree's door opens on breakfast.
lesson: Listening closely shows you what's really going on.
learning: Woodpeckers tap on bark and listen for bugs hiding underneath.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Listens for Breakfast
en-US.text: {sfx:taps} Tap-tap-tap! Someone was knocking on the big tree. {fox:enter} Fox came trotting up, and {deer:enter} {deer:go to fox} Deer came too. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] "Who's there?" called Fox. There, on the bark, was {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker. {deer:face happy} [giggles] "Are you knocking on the tree's front door?" asked Deer. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} "Sort of," said Woodpecker. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Tap-tap-tap… and he listened, very still. {fox:go to woodpecker} Fox tiptoed closer, as quiet as he could. {fox:live listen hold} He pricked up his ears too. [whispers] "What are we listening for?" Deer didn't know, so he {deer:live graze} nibbled the grass. [short pause] Then Fox heard it. {sfx:scritch} Scritch… scratch… munch. Tiny bugs, under the bark! {fox:live listen resume} Fox opened his eyes and grinned. {woodpecker:live tap resume} "Tap!" went Woodpecker. "Breakfast!" {deer:live talk} "Knock, knock!" said Deer. {fox:face happy} {fox:live talk} "Who's there?" said Fox. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] "BREAKFAST!" said everyone.

es-ES.title: ¿Quién llama al árbol?
es-ES.text: {sfx:taps} ¡Toc-toc-toc! Alguien estaba llamando al árbol grande. {fox:enter} Zorro llegó trotando, y {deer:enter} {deer:go to fox} Ciervo detrás. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] —¿Quién es? —preguntó Zorro. Allí, en la corteza, estaba {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero. {deer:face happy} [giggles] —¿Estás llamando a la puerta del árbol? —preguntó Ciervo. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} —Algo así —dijo Carpintero. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Toc-toc-toc… y se quedó escuchando, muy quieto. {fox:go to woodpecker} Zorro se acercó de puntillas, sin hacer ruido. {fox:live listen hold} Y levantó las orejas él también. [whispers] —¿Qué estamos escuchando? Ciervo no lo sabía, así que {deer:live graze} se puso a mordisquear la hierba. [short pause] Entonces Zorro lo oyó. {sfx:scritch} Ris… ras… ñam. ¡Bichitos, debajo de la corteza! {fox:live listen resume} Zorro abrió los ojos y sonrió. {woodpecker:live tap resume} ¡Toc! —¡El desayuno! —pió Carpintero. {deer:live talk} —¡Toc, toc! —dijo Ciervo. {fox:face happy} {fox:live talk} —¿Quién es? —dijo Zorro. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] —¡El DESAYUNO! —gritaron todos.

ja-JP.title: トントン、どなた？
ja-JP.text: {sfx:taps}トントントン！だれかが、大きな木をノックしています。{fox:enter}キツネくんがとことこ、{deer:enter}{deer:go to fox}子ジカもついてきました。{fox:face surprised}{fox:wobble}[curious]「だあれ？」 とキツネくん。みきにとまっていたのは、{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}キツツキくん。{deer:face happy}[giggles]「木のおうちを、ノックしてるの？」 と子ジカ。{woodpecker:face happy}{woodpecker:pulse}「まあね」 とキツツキくん。{woodpecker:live tap hold}トントントン…そして、じっと耳をすませます。{fox:go to woodpecker}キツネくんも、そうっと、そうっとちかよって、{fox:live listen hold}耳をぴんと立てました。[whispers]「なにをきいてるの？」 子ジカはわからないので、{deer:live graze}くさをもぐもぐ。[short pause]そのとき、キツネくんにきこえました。{sfx:scritch}カリ…コリ…むしゃむしゃ。木のかわのしたに、小さな虫たち！{fox:live listen resume}キツネくんは目をあけて、にんまり。{woodpecker:live tap resume}「トン！」 とキツツキくん。「あさごはん！」 {deer:live talk}「トントン！」 と子ジカ。{fox:face happy}{fox:live talk}「はーい、どなた？」 とキツネくん。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]「あさごはーん！」 とみんな。

de-DE.title: Was hört der Specht?
de-DE.text: {sfx:taps} Tock-tock-tock! Jemand klopfte an den großen Baum. {fox:enter} Der Fuchs kam angetrabt, und {deer:enter} {deer:go to fox} das Reh kam auch. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] „Wer ist da?“, rief der Fuchs. Da, an der Rinde, hing {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} der Specht. {deer:face happy} [giggles] „Klopfst du an die Haustür vom Baum?“, fragte das Reh. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} „So ähnlich“, sagte der Specht. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Tock-tock-tock… und dann lauschte er, ganz still. {fox:go to woodpecker} Der Fuchs schlich auf Zehenspitzen näher, so leise er konnte. {fox:live listen hold} Er spitzte auch die Ohren. [whispers] „Was sollen wir denn hören?“ Das Reh wusste es nicht, also {deer:live graze} knabberte es am Gras. [short pause] Dann hörte der Fuchs es. {sfx:scritch} Kritz… kratz… mampf. Winzige Käferchen, unter der Rinde! {fox:live listen resume} Der Fuchs machte die Augen auf und grinste. {woodpecker:live tap resume} „Tock!“, machte der Specht. „Frühstück!“ {deer:live talk} „Klopf, klopf!“, sagte das Reh. {fox:face happy} {fox:live talk} „Wer ist da?“, fragte der Fuchs. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] „FRÜHSTÜCK!“, riefen alle.

fr-FR.title: Le petit-déjeuner de Pic-vert
fr-FR.text: {sfx:taps} Toc-toc-toc ! Quelqu’un frappait au grand arbre. {fox:enter} Renard est arrivé au trot, et {deer:enter} {deer:go to fox} Faon l’a suivi. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] « Qui est là ? » a crié Renard. Là, sur l’écorce, il y avait {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pic-vert. {deer:face happy} [giggles] « Tu frappes à la porte de l’arbre ? » a demandé Faon. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} « Un peu », a dit Pic-vert. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Toc-toc-toc… et il a écouté, sans bouger. {fox:go to woodpecker} Renard s’est approché sur la pointe des pattes, sans un bruit. {fox:live listen hold} Il a dressé les oreilles, lui aussi. [whispers] « Qu’est-ce qu’on écoute ? » Faon n’en savait rien, alors il {deer:live graze} a brouté un peu d’herbe. [short pause] Et puis Renard l’a entendu. {sfx:scritch} Gratte… gratte… miam. De toutes petites bêtes, cachées sous l’écorce ! {fox:live listen resume} Renard a ouvert les yeux et il a souri. {woodpecker:live tap resume} « Toc ! » a fait Pic-vert. « Le petit-déjeuner ! » {deer:live talk} « Toc, toc ! » a dit Faon. {fox:face happy} {fox:live talk} « Qui est là ? » a dit Renard. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] « LE PETIT-DÉJEUNER ! » ont crié tous les amis.

it-IT.title: Chi bussa all'albero?
it-IT.text: {sfx:taps} Toc-toc-toc! Qualcuno bussava al grande albero. {fox:enter} Volpe è arrivata trotterellando, e {deer:enter} {deer:go to fox} Cerbiatto con lei. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] «Chi è?» ha chiamato Volpe. Lì, sulla corteccia, c'era {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Picchio. {deer:face happy} [giggles] «Stai bussando alla porta dell'albero?» ha chiesto Cerbiatto. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} «Più o meno», ha detto Picchio. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Toc-toc-toc… e si è messo in ascolto, immobile. {fox:go to woodpecker} Volpe si è avvicinata in punta di piedi, più silenziosa che poteva. {fox:live listen hold} Ha drizzato le orecchie anche lei. [whispers] «Che cosa stiamo ascoltando?» Cerbiatto non lo sapeva, così {deer:live graze} si è messo a brucare l'erba. [short pause] Poi Volpe l'ha sentito. {sfx:scritch} Cric… crac… gnam. Tanti insettini, sotto la corteccia! {fox:live listen resume} Volpe ha aperto gli occhi e ha sorriso. {woodpecker:live tap resume} «Toc!» ha fatto Picchio. «Colazione!» {deer:live talk} «Toc, toc!» ha detto Cerbiatto. {fox:face happy} {fox:live talk} «Chi è?» ha detto Volpe. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] «La COLAZIONE!» hanno gridato tutti.

zh-TW.title: 啄木鳥聽早餐
zh-TW.text: {sfx:taps}叩叩叩！有誰在敲著大樹。{fox:enter}狐狸小跑步過來，{deer:enter}{deer:go to fox}小鹿也跟著來了。{fox:face surprised}{fox:wobble}[curious]「是誰呀？」 狐狸大聲問。原來是{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥，停在樹皮上。{deer:face happy}[giggles]「你在敲大樹家的門嗎？」 小鹿問。{woodpecker:face happy}{woodpecker:pulse}「差不多啦。」 啄木鳥說。{woodpecker:live tap hold}叩叩叩……然後牠一動也不動，仔細地聽。{fox:go to woodpecker}狐狸踮著腳尖，靜悄悄地走過去。{fox:live listen hold}牠也豎起了耳朵。[whispers]「我們在聽什麼呀？」 小鹿也不知道，所以就{deer:live graze}低頭吃草。[short pause]這時，狐狸聽到了。{sfx:scritch}窸窸……窣窣……喀滋。是小蟲子，躲在樹皮底下吃東西！{fox:live listen resume}狐狸睜開眼睛，咧嘴笑了。{woodpecker:live tap resume}「叩！」 啄木鳥說，「早餐！」 {deer:live talk}「叩叩叩！」 小鹿說。{fox:face happy}{fox:live talk}「是誰呀？」 狐狸說。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]「是早餐！」 大家一起說。

zh-HK.title: 篤篤篤，邊個呀？
zh-HK.text: {sfx:taps}篤篤篤！有誰在敲大樹呢？{fox:enter}狐狸一路小跑過來，{deer:enter}{deer:go to fox}小鹿也來了。{fox:face surprised}{fox:wobble}[curious]「邊個呀？」 狐狸大聲問。樹皮上，原來是{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥。{deer:face happy}[giggles]「你係咪敲緊大樹嘅門呀？」 小鹿問。{woodpecker:face happy}{woodpecker:pulse}「都差唔多啦。」 啄木鳥說。{woodpecker:live tap hold}篤篤篤……然後牠一動不動，用心地聽。{fox:go to woodpecker}狐狸踮起腳尖，靜靜地走近。{fox:live listen hold}牠也豎起耳朵。[whispers]「我哋聽緊乜嘢呀？」 小鹿也不知道，於是{deer:live graze}低頭吃草。[short pause]這時，狐狸聽到了。{sfx:scritch}沙沙……索索……咔嚓。原來是小蟲子，躲在樹皮底下！{fox:live listen resume}狐狸張開眼睛，咧嘴笑了。{woodpecker:live tap resume}「篤！」 啄木鳥說，「早餐！」 {deer:live talk}「篤篤篤！」 小鹿說。{fox:face happy}{fox:live talk}「邊個呀？」 狐狸說。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]「早餐呀！」 大家一起說。
